name: branch_basic
kind: survey: what the YIELD instruction, a BSSY / BSYNC region and a conditional branch cost a warp inside a loop, and what a late arrival at bar.sync costs the warps that were waiting; installs nothing
mechanisms: synchronization.cta (bar.sync, late arrival; supplement to sync_basic v4)
why: Step 2 of dev/design/stall-attribution.md. Every loop kernel of the later steps carries these instructions, and the sync_basic v5 replays leave them as the largest per-pc differences: the instruction behind a YIELD, the instruction behind a BSSY, the instruction behind a BSYNC.
data_seen_before_freezing: sync_basic v1 / v2 / v4 hardware tables and the v5 replays of build 1f831181 ($CYCLESCOPE_ARTIFACT_ROOT/stall-attribution/sync_basic-v5r2), the leaves control.branch, control.reconvergence, instruction.service YIELD and their source records, warp_issue v1 / v2 addenda. No new GPU data.

(a) YIELD. ptxas puts one YIELD (stall 5, yield bit 1) at the head of a try_wait retry loop on both targets. In u.selfwait the hardware has, per execution, wait 5.9 / 6.9 on the YIELD (its stall) and branch_resolving 40.5 (h100) / 40.9 (b300) on the try_wait that follows it; t.mbar_pingpong gives 42 per execution on h100. The replay has control_floor 112 on h100 (instruction.service YIELD completion 113.15, source control_yield.h100.r2: a compiled spin loop) and 4 on b300 (leaf 1; control_yield b300-r3 found no YIELD in the compiled probe). warp_issue v1 / v2: a NOP with yield bit 1 and stall 0 costs 33.4 cycles per instruction.

(b) BSSY / BSYNC. s.mbar_arrive (a region around a lane-predicated arrive, no YIELD, lanes diverge): hardware 0.7 cycles on the instruction behind the BSSY and branch_resolving 3.4-3.7 + wait 2 on the instruction behind the BSYNC, 27.0 per iteration in all; the replay puts 32.4 per execution behind each BSSY (control.reconvergence: 33 x control_path_count, source reconvergence.h100.r3, compiled probes) and 48.4 per iteration. In u.selfwait and t.mbar_pingpong the region holds the YIELD, so (a) and (b) are not separated by the existing cells.

(c) Branch. s.loop: a taken backward branch costs its stall (3) and about 5 cycles at its target (branch_resolving 2.8 + no_instruction 2.0 per trip of the four-fold unrolled loop); the replay has 5.2 there (control.branch 6.05 for a taken branch). No cell with a taken forward branch or a not-taken branch in a loop without a region.

(d) bar.sync, late arrival (sync_basic v4 addendum): the clock read right behind BAR.SYNC.DEFER_BLOCKING issues before the warp blocks (the warp stops on the third instruction behind the BAR), so the v4 cells could not show when each waiting warp resumes; the late warp's period is +0.4 / +6 at 4 warps and +33 / +21 at 16 warps (h100 / b300).

probe.chain: tools/microbench/sync_basic harness (cells.tsv, probe/, loop gate, run.sh, derive.py; case names mb-sb-<cell>): hand-written PTX -> ptxas -O3 -> pass-through or a free-mode sass_patch plan -> nvdisasm listing -> ptx_runner; capture, two reference passes (per-pc samples at the densest interval, counters, clocks), replay with engine build 1f831181. A cell whose listing does not have the stated form is recorded as unrealised; the listing decides.
probe.frame v (plan cells): v.loop.ptx: every thread reads the clock, runs a loop of N = 64 iterations with a run-time bound whose body is K filler pairs (shr / xor on a scratch register), reads the clock, stores t0, t1, the iteration count (check word, must be 64) and the scratch register. ptxas' unrolling is taken as it comes. A free-mode plan rewrites the filler slots of every unrolled copy identically and leaves the counter, the compare, the branch and every label-referencing word in place; S = filler slots per iteration. The YIELD word comes from a donor function in the same module (a try_wait retry loop, never launched). NOP means NOP with stall 1, yield bit 1 unless stated.

cells v.v.nop: all S slots NOP: the frame.
cells v.v.yield1: slot 0 = YIELD (stall 5, yield bit 1, as ptxas emits it), the rest NOP.
cells v.v.yield1.s1: as v.yield1 with the YIELD's stall field 1.
cells v.v.yield1.y0: as v.yield1 with the YIELD's yield bit 0.
cells v.v.yield1.alu: slot 0 = YIELD, slot 1 = the frame's own second filler instruction (an ALU instruction), the rest NOP.
cells v.v.yield2: YIELD in slot 0 and in slot S/2, the rest NOP.
cells v.v.nopy.s0: slot 0 = NOP with stall 0 and yield bit 1, the rest NOP (the warp_issue reading inside a loop).
cells v.shapes: v.nop and v.yield1 at 1, 4, 8 and 16 warps per CTA (one CTA per SM: 1 warp per SM, then 1, 2 and 4 warps per SMSP); the other cells at 1 warp.

cells w (pass-through).frame: loop of N = 64 iterations; per iteration a conditional region `if (p) { body }` whose body ptxas does not turn into predicated instructions (the listing must show BSSY, one conditional BRA, the body, BSYNC and no YIELD inside the loop), then the counter. Check word = number of iterations.
cells w (pass-through).w.if.nt: p false in every lane (compared with a run-time value so that it is not folded).
cells w (pass-through).w.if.div: p true in lanes 0-15 only (the warp diverges every iteration).
cells w (pass-through).w.ifelse.div: if / else with a body on each side, lanes 0-15 / 16-31.
cells w (pass-through).w.ubr.t / w.ubr.nt: the same body behind a branch on a predicate ptxas knows to be uniform (derived from a kernel parameter only): taken forward branch over the body / not taken. Whether a BSSY appears is read from the listing and reported.

cells u (pass-through, eight words per t.u.bar_late3: u.bar_late with the clock read moved behind the instructions the warp still issues after BAR.SYNC.DEFER_BLOCKING: at least three instructions between the BAR and the S2UR SR_CLOCKLO in the listing (gate). W warps per CTA, warp 0 runs delay(64) before each bar.sync; every warp sums the clock before the bar.sync and the clock after it. Shapes W = 4, 8, 16, 32.

derivation.per cell: period = (t1 - t0) / N per warp (median over the lanes of a warp, then over warps, launches 0 and 2); sample total per iteration over the loop-body pcs (every class, each scaled by its counter, mean of the passes with at least 2000 samples); the per-pc table of hardware classes against replay ledger reasons (derive.py).
derivation.YIELD: C(cell) = sample total(cell) - sample total(v.nop of the same shape), and the same from the clocks; where the samples put it (class and pc).
derivation.region: sample total of each w cell minus the body's own instructions; classes on the BSSY, the BRA, the first body instruction, the BSYNC and the instruction behind it.
derivation.bar late: per warp Z = (sum of the clocks after - sum of the clocks before) / N; R(w) = Z(w) - Z(late warp) orders the resumption of the waiting warps relative to the late arrival; the late warp's period against u.bar_late.w1 (v4).

questions_before_data.Q1 (what the YIELD costs): Candidates: (Y-a) a fixed time before the warp's next issue, about 40 cycles, whatever follows and whatever the control word: C(v.yield1) = C(v.yield1.alu) = C(v.yield1.s1) + 4 = C(v.yield1.y0), C(v.yield2) = 2 C(v.yield1). (Y-b) the cost is the yield bit acting with the stall field as in warp_issue (33.4 per instruction with yield bit 1 and stall 0) and the opcode is irrelevant: v.nopy.s0 costs what a YIELD costs less its stall, and v.yield1.y0 costs only the stall. (Y-c) it belongs to the try_wait or the retry loop, not to the YIELD: C(v.yield1) is near the stall alone.
questions_before_data.Q2 (other warps): With 2 and 4 warps per SMSP: (W-a) each warp pays the same C; (W-b) C falls because the warp is rescheduled as soon as another warp has issued; (W-c) C rises with the number of warps. Read from C at 4, 8, 16 warps and from the not_selected samples.
questions_before_data.Q3 (region): (R-a) BSSY and BSYNC cost only their stall fields when the warp does not diverge, and a divergent region adds a fixed amount per reconvergence (the 3.4-4.1 branch_resolving behind the BSYNC) plus the two paths' instructions; (R-b) a cost per region proportional to the number of paths, as the installed leaf has it (33 per path on h100). Read from w.if.nt / .t / .div / w.ifelse.div.
questions_before_data.Q4 (branch): Cost of a taken forward branch and of a not-taken branch against the installed 6.05 / 0 (h100): w.ubr.t, w.ubr.nt, w.if.nt, w.if.t.
questions_before_data.Q5 (bar late): (B-a) the waiting warps resume one after another: R(w) grows by a constant per warp in some order; (B-b) they resume together and the late warp's extra period at 16 and 32 warps is issue-slot competition on its SMSP: R(w) equal for all waiting warps, not_selected on the late warp's delay loop; (B-c) neither: reported.

install: Nothing. The readings go into the addenda; an installation protocol (YIELD leaf, reconvergence leaf, bar.sync law) is frozen afterwards against these numbers.
not_allowed: No value from another machine or from the literature; no full-GPU case used to choose a rule or a value; no cell dropped after its data is seen (an unrealised listing is recorded before the run).

addenda.text: The replays use the current formal build 5aa9cc49 (sync_basic v5 full-GPU addendum: build 1f831181 released a dependency barrier at the first of two pending wait results); the 110 sync_basic small-kernel ledgers are byte-identical between the two builds. Cell names in the harness: v.* (plan cells), w.* (regions and branches), u.bar_late3.* (eight words per thread).

addenda.when: 2026-11-17, h100 and b300 runs (23 cells each: 12 v, 7 w, 4 u.bar_late3; every gate passed; data $CYCLESCOPE_ARTIFACT_ROOT/stall-attribution/branch_basic/<device> (w, u) and branch_basic-v/<device> (v); tables branch_basic-readings/read-<device>.txt from tools/microbench/branch_basic/readings.py; replay build 5aa9cc49) - readings; nothing installed
addenda.text: VALIDITY. v.nopy.s0 is unrealised (NOP with stall 0 and yield bit 1 does not decode). The first v run is void: the plans gave every filler NOP stall 1, the NOP between the counter add and its compare let the compare read the stale counter (check word 68); the plans were regenerated with each NOP keeping the stall of the instruction it replaces (a3c7c44d) and the 12 v cells run again (check words right, cubin hashes checked). The first w.if / w.ifelse sources tested the loop counter from the second iteration on and were corrected before any run (71ed0204); the body counters are right on both devices (check_w_values.py). Residency at a pc is the time from the previous instruction's issue to this one's, so an instruction's stall and what it costs are read on the row behind it. YIELD (Q1, Q2). Cost per YIELD = sample total minus v.nop of the same shape, 1 warp: h100 48.84 (v.yield1), 48.23 (.y0), 48.14 (.alu), 47.42 (v.yield2 / 2), 47.54 (.s1); b300 48.13, 47.45, 47.48, 47.09, 47.91; the clocks give 47.3-48.7. The replaced NOP had stall 2, so from the YIELD's issue to the warp's next issue it is 50.0 (h100) / 49.6 (b300) (mean of the five cells), the same with stall 5 and stall 1, yield bit 1 and 0, a NOP or an ALU instruction behind it, and exactly twice for two YIELDs: Y-a holds, with the YIELD's own stall inside the time (a floor, not an addition); Y-b and Y-c are refuted. The samples put it on the instruction behind the YIELD (branch_resolving 40.9 + wait 4 + no_instruction 2-3 + misc 2 + selected 2 per execution); with stall 1 the instruction right behind issues and the time is on the second one. Other warps: 4 / 8 / 16 warps per CTA 47.50 / 47.45 / 50.92 (h100), 47.89 / 48.12 / 49.43 (b300): W-a, every warp pays the same; at 4 warps per SMSP not_selected adds 1.5-3. Replay: 109.75 per YIELD on h100 (leaf 113.15), 1.75 on b300. REGION (Q3), cycles per execution on the row behind (x 4 of the per-iteration tables; both devices agree within 0.3 unless two values are given). BSSY costs its stall (4) and nothing else, with or without divergence. BSYNC: from its issue to the next issue 13.0 (wait 4.2 + branch_resolving 7.7-8.2 + selected 1) in w.if.nt / .t, 12.95 in u.bar_late3, 13.4 / 12.7 in u.selfwait, 12.2 in s.mbar_arrive; every BSYNC here has stall 5. A divergent region runs its paths one after the other and each path ends on the BSYNC: behind the BSYNC 23.5 (w.if.div) and 23.8 (w.ifelse.div) = twice the uniform value; the first instruction of the fall-through path carries 1.6-2.1 more than in the uniform cell; nothing else. Sample totals per iteration: w.if.nt 31.89 / 32.14, .t 41.55 / 42.34, .div 60.22 / 60.14, .div.w4 60.31 / 60.74, w.ifelse.div 94.04 / 94.12 (h100 / b300). R-a holds; R-b (a cost per region proportional to the path count) is refuted: the replay has 32-33 per path behind every BSSY (w.if.nt 50.31, .t 63.38, .div 101.38; w.ifelse.div 99.00, right in sum only) and only the stall behind the BSYNC. BRANCH (Q4). A taken branch: from its issue to the issue of the target 10.0-10.6 (h100) / 10.1-10.4 (b300), forward (w.ubr.t) and backward (s.loop, v.nop, w.if.nt, w.ubr.t) alike; about half of it is sampled as wait / selected on the fall-through pc (outside the loop listing for a back-edge) and half as branch_resolving + no_instruction on the target. The back-edge of v.nop has stall 6 and gives 9.9 / 10.2, the others have stall 5: the time does not grow with the stall, so it is a floor as the engine has it, not an addition; the installed value (6.05 / 5.78, control_branch: slope minus a body that holds a dependent FFMA chain) is 4 short. A not-taken branch costs its stall (w.ubr.nt 24.79 / 25.39 against replay 25.38 / 25.59). The uniform-predicate branch has no BSSY on either target. w.ubr.t h100 has 1898 / 1881 samples per pass (below the 2000 rule of derive.py; read with the passes as they are: 15.96, b300 15.94); replay 12.44 / 11.17. BAR LATE (Q5): not answered by Z. The warp that waits does not stop at a fixed distance behind BAR.SYNC.DEFER_BLOCKING: it issues the three adds and the clock read (CS2R) and stops on the LDC (h100) / LDCU (b300) behind them (class barrier there: 496 / 486 per iteration at 4 warps), as it stopped on the LDC two instructions behind the BAR in u.bar_late and on the next BAR or on the back-edge BRA in s.bar: it runs on until the first instruction that is not a plain ALU instruction or a clock read (seen: LDC, LDCU, BAR, BRA). So Z is 9 in every warp at 4 and 8 warps (the path itself); at 16 and 32 warps the waiting warps have 9-21 (h100) and 9-35 (b300), which is competition for the issue slots of these four instructions, not an order of resumption. The late warp itself has Z = 9 at every shape: no latency for the last arrival. Periods (all warps equal): h100 751.2 / 762.3 / 787.6 / 841.4, b300 722.2 / 730.1 / 744.0 / 788.4 at 4 / 8 / 16 / 32 warps: +11 / +36 / +90 and +8 / +22 / +66 over 4 warps, against +8 / +24 / +56 from the law for simultaneous arrival (2.0 per warp): b300 follows it to 16 warps, h100 is 3.2 per warp; not_selected grows with it (h100 7.1 / 20.7 per iteration at 16 / 32). B-a (resumption one after another) can neither be shown nor excluded with these cells; B-b accounts for part of the h100 excess. Replay 715 / 718 / 743 / 798 (h100), 674 / 675 / 679 / 706 (b300): short by 34-38 (h100) and 44-72 (b300) per iteration, with the wait booked on the instruction right behind the BAR.
